business_job: Let a user choose the right professional category by transaction stage, city, language, and verification level.
required_fields: category, city, service_stage, language, verification_status, disclosure_status, updated_at
primary_controls: category tiles, city selector, language selector, transaction-stage selector, verification explainer
trust_rule: Show only category-level claims until enough verified profiles exist.
seo_owner_rule: The hub targets professional navigation intent, not city money keywords.
lead_rule: Leads route through a neutral category intake unless a verified profile is selected.

audience: Users looking for a specific service type
business_job: Convert service intent into verified profile discovery without fake recommendations.
required_fields: category, specialties, cities_served, languages, credentials, review_status, contact_channels
primary_controls: filters, sort by verified fit, profile cards, empty state, disclosure drawer
trust_rule: No rating, recommendation, or review count unless backed by real review data and moderation policy.
seo_owner_rule: Category page owns broad service intent such as lawyers, appraisers, mortgage advisors, inspectors.
lead_rule: If profile is unclaimed or not approved, lead routes to category intake, not directly to the professional.

business_job: Match a service type to a city or metro area while avoiding thin city pages.
required_fields: category, city, area, proximity_note, profiles_count, verification_coverage, source_date
primary_controls: city filter, nearby areas, verified-only toggle, language toggle, transaction-stage filter
trust_rule: Index only when there are enough verified profiles or a useful city-specific explanation.
seo_owner_rule: City-category page owns local service intent only, not apartment/project intent.
lead_rule: Route leads to verified local profiles first; otherwise show missing-supply request form.

business_job: Show a verified, current, disclosure-safe provider profile with contact options and limitations.
required_fields: display_name, category, license_or_credential, verification_status, languages, service_areas, disclosures, contact_methods, review_dates
primary_controls: call, WhatsApp, form, save, report issue, claim profile
trust_rule: Do not publish strong credentials until reviewed against the relevant official source or professional document.
seo_owner_rule: Profile targets provider/entity intent, not the city money keyword by itself.
lead_rule: Contact is logged with source surface, page family, professional id, and user consent state.

business_job: Suggest relevant professional help from the project context without stealing the project lead.
required_fields: project reference, city, transaction stage, category links, verified profiles, disclosure status
primary_controls: contextual category chips, small profile rail, lead split choice
trust_rule: Provider rail is secondary to the project decision flow and must not hide project CTAs.
seo_owner_rule: Project page remains canonical for project demand; professional module links to service pages as support.
lead_rule: Lead modal asks whether the user wants project info, professional help, or both.

business_job: Offer help for legal review, mortgage, appraisal, inspection, design, and remote purchase at the right moment.
primary_controls: stage-based helper tray, category CTA, no-intrusion contact dock
trust_rule: Only show professional assistance after a clear unit or project context exists.
seo_owner_rule: Showroom does not target professional keywords; it links to relevant service pages.
lead_rule: Professional lead keeps project and unit context only when user submits consent.

business_job: Route informational readers to the right service category without cannibalizing the guide.
primary_controls: inline support box, end-of-guide CTA, expert-review note
trust_rule: Legal, tax, finance, and appraisal topics require reviewer fields before strong claims.
seo_owner_rule: Guide owns informational intent; service directory owns provider intent; money page owns transaction intent.
lead_rule: Lead copy says consultation request, not binding advice.

business_job: Connect English readers to language-capable professionals and concierge intake.
required_fields: language, country_context, buyer_stage, category, profile_languages, disclosure_status
primary_controls: language filter, remote-flow CTA, concierge form, verified status
trust_rule: Do not provide tax, legal, mortgage, or immigration advice as site content.
seo_owner_rule: English pages own foreign-buyer education and concierge intent, not Israeli local service pages.
lead_rule: Lead routes to concierge first unless the user explicitly selects a profile.

business_job: Collect profile, license, service, language, media, disclosure, and package data before publication.
required_fields: provider_type, legal_name, public_name, license_number_optional, documents, cities, languages, packages, disclosures
primary_controls: step form, upload fields, review status, owner approval gate
trust_rule: Nothing public until minimum verification and owner approval are complete.
seo_owner_rule: Intake pages stay private or noindex unless deliberately exposed as a provider signup page.
lead_rule: Submissions create a review task, not a public listing.

business_job: Operate profiles, verification, disclosures, routing, complaints, and stale reviews from one registry.
required_fields: profile_id, status, source_url, reviewer, expiry_date, disclosure_state, lead_destination, last_contact_test
primary_controls: list view, filters, bulk status, evidence links, stale alert
trust_rule: Stale or disputed profiles are hidden or downgraded until reviewed.
seo_owner_rule: Admin pages are private and never indexed.
lead_rule: Each profile has one approved lead destination and fallback destination.

business_job: Accept issue reports without publishing unverified negative or positive claims.
primary_controls: report issue button, moderation queue, owner notes
trust_rule: Reviews and complaints are not public until policy, consent, and moderation are approved.
seo_owner_rule: Review content does not create separate indexable pages by default.
lead_rule: Issue reports route to owner queue, not directly to the provider.

business_job: Separate relevance, verification, and commercial placement so trust is not sold invisibly.
primary_controls: sort selector, disclosure text, placement marker, explanation drawer
trust_rule: Paid placement may affect visibility only with clear disclosure and never replaces verification.
seo_owner_rule: Pages may explain sorting, but do not target ranking-policy keywords as money pages.
lead_rule: Leads from paid placement preserve disclosure state for reporting.
